BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing property tax relief; and adding a newsection to chapter 84.55 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 84.55 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state property tax levy for collection in 2015 through 2039must be reduced by three hundred forty million dollars each calendaryear from the amount that would otherwise be allowed under this chapterwithout regard to this section. (2) State levies for collection in 2040 and thereafter must be setat the amount that would be allowed otherwise under this chapter if thestate levies for collection in 2015 through 2039 had been set withoutthe reduction under subsection (1) of this section.
